text:
Jean-Gabriel Pageau has spent the last week as a game-time decision. He missed the Islanders' game on Nov. 17 and was slated to play two nights later after being listed day to day, according to CBS Sports. At 34, the body is part of the story now.

When he plays, he is still a center coaches trust: 15.7 minutes a night, faceoffs, penalty kill, 42 hits in 18 games. He has 1 goal and 7 assists. The single goal is unlucky. He has 2.58 expected goals on his own shots, and his shooting percentage is 4.5%, against a range of about 12% to 17% for him.

The worry is the five-on-five play. The Islanders get 45% of the expected goals with him on, 6 points worse than without him. Last season Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level, with opponents getting more chances against him than against nearly any forward (bottom 4%). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking does show strengths: 73% of his exits kept possession. Watch whether his health holds, and whether the defensive numbers recover once it does.
headline: Banged up, still out there
